script.title: THE NERVOUS PUPPY
script.title_quote: He's not nervous, he's a backup dancer.
script.scene_zh: 獸醫診所 · 疫苗掛號
script.story_hook: A jumpy little dog needs his annual shot.
script.intro_zh: 一隻坐不住的小狗，要來打年度疫苗。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today a dog owner books a vaccination. Listen for pet and clinic phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天一位狗主人幫狗狗預約疫苗。留意寵物與診所的說法。
script.outro: Shot booked, snacks ready, happy dog. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 針約好了，零食備好了，狗狗開心。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each vet-booking phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀診所預約的說法。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful woman in her early thirties with black hair in a high ponytail, wearing a mustard cardigan over a white tee, dark jeans and white sneakers, average build, holding a small leash
script.char_b_description: a young man in his twenties with short bleached-blond hair, wearing a navy clinic polo, khaki pants, white athletic shoes, slim build, a stethoscope toy keychain on his belt

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I'd like to book a shot for Mango.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ʃɑɹ fɚ ˈmæŋɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你好！我想幫 Mango 預約打預防針。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The little brown rocket? Hi, I'm Ben.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪtəl braʊn ˈɹɑkət haɪ aɪm bɛn/
dialogue.zh: 是那隻棕色小火箭嗎？你好，我是班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, yes. You met him last year.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ jɛs ju mɛt hɪm læst jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，對，他去年見過你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I remember the zoomies! So, yearly checkup?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɹɪˈmɛmbɚ ðə ˈzumiz soʊ ˈjɪɹli ˈtʃɛkˌʌp/
dialogue.zh: 記得他亂衝！今年也是年度檢查嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the annual one, plus the rabies shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ði ˈænjuəl wʌn plʌs ðə ˈɹeɪbiz ʃɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 對，年度那一針，還有狂犬病疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. Saturday morning opens at nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfəkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˈoʊpənz æt naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 時間正巧。週六早上九點開診。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine works. Um, does he need to fast?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn wɜɹks ʌm dʌz hi nid tə fæst/
dialogue.zh: 九點可以。呃，他需要禁食嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fasting for shots. Just breakfast, sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈfæstɪŋ fɚ ʃɑɹts dʒʌst ˈbɹɛkfəst ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 打針不用禁食，早餐照吃沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, he's never missed one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt hɪz ˈnɛvɚ mɪst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 好，他可從來不錯過吃飯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some dogs shake at the clinic. Does he?
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm dɑɡz ʃeɪk æt ðə ˈklɪnɪk dʌz hi/
dialogue.zh: 有些狗在診所會發抖，他會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, he barks at the door for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ hi bɑɹks æt ðə dɔɹ fɚ tɛn ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 噢，他會對著門叫十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The scary door? It's glass. He sees every face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈskɛɹi dɔɹ ɪts ɡlæs hi siz ˈɛvɹi feɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那扇可怕的門？其實是玻璃，他看得到每張臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him that. He thinks mailmen are villains.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm ðæt hi θɪŋks ˈmeɪlˌmɛn ɑɹ ˈvɪlənz/
dialogue.zh: 你跟他說吧，他覺得郵差都是壞人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! We'll use the quiet room, skip the wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wil juz ðə ˈkwaɪɪt rum skɪp ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！我們用安靜診間，不用在外面候診。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helps. Last time he danced on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlps læst taɪm hi dænst ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 有幫助，上次他在診療台上跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's not nervous, he's a backup dancer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz ˈnɜɹvəs hɪz ə ˈbækˌʌp ˈdænsɚ/
dialogue.zh: 他不是緊張，他是伴舞演員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly what I tell my neighbors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli wʌt aɪ tɛl maɪ ˈneɪˌbɚz/
dialogue.zh: 我都是這樣跟鄰居解釋的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, his records... hmm, that's a problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hɪz ɹɪˈkɔɹdz hʌm ðæts ə ˈpɹɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 好，他的病歷……嗯，有點問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What? He got every shot as a puppy!
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt hi ɡɑt ˈɛvɹi ʃɑɹt əz ə ˈpʌpi/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼了？他小狗的時候每一針都打過了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old clinic never sent his file over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈklɪnɪk ˈnɛvɚ sɛnt hɪz ˈfaɪəl ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 前一間診所都沒把檔案傳過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Do we start all over?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ du wi stɑɹt ɔl ˈoʊvɚ/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那要從頭打嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe not. Do you have a photo of it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi nɑt du ju hæv ə ˈfoʊɾoʊ əv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 也許不用，你有拍過紀錄的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait... the booklet! It's in my bag. Found it!
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈbʊkˌlɪt ɪts ɪn maɪ bæɡ faʊnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等……手冊！在我包裡。找到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Stamps from the old vet, dated last June.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs stæmps fɹʌm ði oʊld vɛt ˈdeɪtɪd læst dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！舊獸醫的蓋章，去年六月的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we're saved?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪɹ seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 那就沒問題了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're saved. I'll scan this for the file.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ seɪvd aɪl skæn ðɪs fɚ ðə faɪəl/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題了，我掃描存檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. So, same time Saturday?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju soʊ seɪm taɪm ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呼，那就週六同一時間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked in. Ever had a bad reaction after a shot?
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt ɪn ˈɛvɚ hæd ə bæd ɹiˈækʃən ˈæftɚ ə ʃɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 搞定了。他之前打完針，有過不好的反應嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, once his tummy hurt for a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm wʌns hɪz ˈtʌmɪ hɜɹt fɚ ə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，有一次他肚子不舒服一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common, and mild. Walk him after, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən ænd maɪld wɔk hɪm ˈæftɚ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 常見也輕微，不過打完要帶他散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walk? He bounces off the walls all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk hi ˈbaʊnsəz ɔf ðə wɔlz ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 散步？他整天在家蹦蹦跳跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that counts double.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ðæt kaʊnts ˈdʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 那正好，這樣算兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Should I bring treats for the wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃʊd aɪ bɹɪŋ tɹiːts fɚ ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！等待時要帶零食安撫他嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small ones. We also sell peanut cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs smɔl wʌnz wɪ ˈɔlsoʊ sɛl ˈpitˌnʊt ˈkʊkiz/
dialogue.zh: 要呀，小的最好。我們也有賣花生餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'd marry those cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiːd ˈmɛɹi ðoʊz ˈkʊkiz/
dialogue.zh: 他簡直想跟那些餅乾結婚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quick safety question. Has he nipped anyone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kwɪk ˈseɪfti ˈkwɛstʃən hæz hi nɪpt ˈɛnɪˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 問個安全問題，他有咬過人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the mailman's legend says yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈmeɪlˌmænz ˈlɛdʒənd sɛz jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 只有郵差的傳說裡說有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! A sign on his cage says he nipped once.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ə saɪn ɑn hɪz keɪdʒ sɛz hi nɪpt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！他的籠子上可掛著「咬過一次」的牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He caught my sleeve once. Nobody got hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kɑt maɪ sliv wʌns ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɡɑt hɜɹt/
dialogue.zh: 他有一次咬到我袖口，沒人受傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll skip the cage, use an open table.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl skɪp ðə keɪdʒ juz æn ˈoʊpən ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 那我們不用籠子，採開放式診療台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've thought of everything. Thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv θɔt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你想得好周到，謝謝你！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My job's easy with tidy files. One more thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dʒɑbz ˈizi wɪð ˈtaɪdi ˈfaɪəlz wʌn mɔɹ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 檔案整齊，我的工作就輕鬆。還有件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The reminder? Text it to me, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɹɪˈmaɪndɚ tɛkst ɪt tə mi pliz/
dialogue.zh: 提醒嗎？請用訊息傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already queued. Also, a monthly reminder?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɛɹdi kjud ˈɔlsoʊ ə ˈmʌnθli ɹɪˈmaɪndɚ/
dialogue.zh: 已經排好了。另外，要不要每月提醒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Monthly? For what, his teeth?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌnθli fɚ wʌt hɪz tiθz/
dialogue.zh: 每月？是做什麼，牙齒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heartworm pills. It's spring, and they're due.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑɹtˌwɜɹm pɪlz ɪts spɹɪŋ ænd ðɛr dju/
dialogue.zh: 是心絲蟲藥，春天到了，該補了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that pill he hides in cheese?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt pɪl hi haɪdz ɪn tʃiz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，就是那顆他藏在起司裡的藥？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one! We can refill it Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn wi kæn ˈɹifɪl ɪt ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是那顆！週五可以幫他補藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add that to my Saturday, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðæt tə maɪ ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就一起排進週六吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Shot plus pills, nine sharp, Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʃɑɹt plʌs pɪlz naɪn ʃɑɹp ˈsætɚˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，疫苗加藥，週六九點整。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay today, or after the visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ təˈdeɪ ɔɹ ˈæftɚ ðə ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 可以今天就付款，還是看完再付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We bill after visits. Booking's free today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bɪl ˈæftɚ ˈvɪzɪts ˈbʊkɪŋz fri təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 看完才計費，今天掛號免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free booking, kind words, scanned file. Wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈbʊkɪŋ kaɪnd wɜɹdz skænd ˈfaɪəl waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 免費掛號、暖心的話、又幫忙掃描，真棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He's a regular already. Hi there, Mango.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiːz ə ˈɹɛɡjəlɚ ɔlˈɛɾdi haɪ ðɛɹ ˈmæŋɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 他已經是這裡的老朋友了。你好呀，Mango！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's shaking your hand? He does that!
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ jʊɹ hænd hi dʌz ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 他在跟你握手？他都會這樣！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Saturday, nine. Quiet room, open table.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈsætɚˌdeɪ naɪn ˈkwaɪɪt rum ˈoʊpən ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 看見了吧？週六九點，安靜診間、開放診療台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll be the ones laughing loudly.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl bi ði wʌnz ˈlæfɪŋ ˈlaʊdli/
dialogue.zh: 到時大笑的一定是我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll save you the front spot. Bye, rocket!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl seɪv ju ðə frʌnt spɑt baɪ ˈɹɑkət/
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你們留最早的位置。再見，小火箭！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye, Ben! Saturday can't come fast enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ bɛn ˈsætɚˌdeɪ kænt kʌm fæst ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 再見，班！真希望週六馬上就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text me if plans change. Have a good one!
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst mi ɪf plænz tʃeɪndʒ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 行程有變動就傳訊息給我。祝你愉快！

script.youtube_title: 【🐶「他不是緊張，是伴舞！」】🎧60句獸醫診所聽力練習｜疫苗預約・病歷缺檔・安靜診間｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🌱A2｜Booking a Dog Vaccination
script.youtube_title_en: "He's Not Nervous, He's a Backup Dancer" — Booking a Dog Vaccination
script.youtube_description:
60句獸醫診所聽力練習：幫狗狗約年度疫苗，病歷卻沒從舊診所傳過來，怎麼辦？

這一集跟著一位狗主人和診所助理，從預約時間、聊狗狗怕看診的趣事、翻出手冊救回病歷，到安排安靜診間、零食安撫與心絲蟲補藥，把寵物看診的英文聽熟。

你會聽到：
- 預約說法：「I'd like to book a shot for Mango.」
- 描述行為：「He barks at the door for ten minutes.」
- 解決缺檔：「Do you have a photo of it?」
- 術後照顧：「Walk him after, though.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每週都有生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of vet-clinic listening practice: a dog owner comes in to book the annual shot, and the puppy's file never arrived from the old clinic. Panic? No — there's a trick with an old booklet.

You will hear how to book a vaccination, describe your pet's behavior, solve missing records, ask about side effects, set reminders, and make a nervous dog feel like a backup dancer. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.thumbnail_action: holding a tiny dog on a leash
